text: A commercial airline ceases all operations after failing to secure sufficient capital, ending its participation in the market. Operational flows stop immediately, and workforce and service capacity are removed from the system. Market structure adjusts as remaining carriers absorb displaced demand.

meta.note: Fragmentation reflects removal of a node from network rather than internal division.

text: Cash reserves increase to record levels within a single entity as inflows exceed deployment through acquisitions or investments. Equity positions are reduced, shihfting capital from external holdings into internal reserves while core operating earnings continue to expand.

meta.note: Concentration reflects internal capital accumulation rather than external market dominance.
